newsitem.title: USA: DT Industries backs analysts estimate.
newsitem.headline: DT Industries backs analysts estimate.

text.p: DT Industries Inc said Wednesday it continues to back the consensus of analysts' earnings projections for fiscal 1997 of $2.39 a share, compared with $1.50 a year ago.
Earlier, DT, which makes automated production systems, said it remained comfortable with internal projections for the remainder of the fiscal year.
Later, a spokesman said the company's internal projections are consistent with the consensus Street estimate.

DT reported second quarter earnings of $0.58 a share, up from $0.34 a year ago. According to First Call, the mean estimate for the second quarter ended December 29 was $0.57 a share. DT shares were down one at 36.
